notes.title: New (optional) Look!
notes.content:
Added: 'Skin' setting. Like the name implies, this setting changes the look of nearly the whole game.
Added: A reticle setting. If you can't really see your cursor when playing, you should try using this
Added: A warning screen for epilepsy

I unfortunately had to remove the zoom feature for now

Rearranged the settings page as well.

Overall, a pretty good content update!
